Context: 7. Leave Entitlements for Vacation Department Staff

10. Benefit of leave to teachers in Vacation Departments.Persons serving in Vacation Departments (including Teachers) have been extended the benefit of leave under the provisions of Rule 28 of Leave Rules, for the duration in which such staff have been utilized for school works/ activities during vacations. - GID (9), Rule 28.
